```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(performance)
library(vegan)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(mclogit)

annot_master<-read.csv(here("Data", "cluster_and_ed50_data.csv")) #from phenotype_heatmap script
df_modeling <- annot_master %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("K_"), site), as.factor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(site))

k_cols <- paste0("K_", 2:15)
```

```{r}
#mclogit package provides a function called mblogit specifically for multinomial baseline-category logit models with random effects.

# Ensure R knows these are categorical names, not math numbers
# 1. Filter out empty sites AND rare group categories (2 and 4)
df_icra_clean <- subset(df_icra, 
                        !site %in% c(7, 8) & 
                        K_10 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 10))

table(df_icra_clean$site, df_icra_clean$K_10)

# Fit a multinomial baseline category logit model with a random intercept
icra_m10_multi <- mblogit(K_10 ~ ED50, 
                          random = ~ 1 | site, 
                          data = df_icra_clean)
summary(icra_m10_multi)
```
